groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.region: Administrative region of the department, fixed metadata.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.history: Fewer than 8 versus at least 8 usable lentil years strictly before decision.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.volatility: Historical lentil sample SD / mean. Annual tercile cutoffs use only historical department representatives with at least 3 observations.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.yield_level: Historical mean lentil yield, split by the annual median of historical department representatives with at least 3 observations.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.idf_donor: Fixed project donor departments 10, 28, 45, 89 versus other observed departments; not an Ile-de-France field validation.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.original_cohort: 133 original archived cases versus 59 added cases. Retrospective audit only, not a deployable selection feature.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.harvest_collapse: Ex post: realised lentil yield below 60% of its strictly historical department mean.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.extreme_weather: Ex post: target-year March-July rain outside historical local P10-P90, or days above 30C exceeding historical local P90.
groups_fixed_before_score_inspection.wheat_price_shock: Ex post: realised wheat price exceeds 1.2 times the latest earlier annual price.

bootstrap_unit: whole evaluation year; paired candidate-minus-baseline differences
interpretation: Exploratory subgroup diagnostics, not model selection using future subgroup outcomes.
